Kraan.setting: the bare peak of a steep hill, a forest canopy on the slopes below
Kraan.prompt: A Kraan: a huge flying beast, with vast dark bat-like wings whose ribbed edges end in hooked claws, a long tapering body with a scaly back, clawed feet and a long head with a mouth full of razor-sharp fangs; saddle straps cross its back. It dives out of the sky at the viewer, wings beating hard enough to buffet a man off his feet, its fanged jaws snapping shut just short of the viewer's head.
beyond: ribbed, clawed wing edges, saddle straps: ill3
long head, clawed feet: ill3

Vordak.setting: a narrow forest track among close trees
Vordak.prompt: A Vordak: a tall undead figure standing upright on two legs as a man does, in long, ragged hooded robes, the hood drooping over a hideous, fleshless face with deep-set glinting eyes, skeletal fingers gripping a huge, heavy dark mace. It has just spun round on the track; with a piercing, blood-freezing scream it raises the mace high above its head and charges at the viewer, a chilling force pressing out from it at the mind.
beyond: spiked mace head: ill3
drooping hood: ill8
glinting eyes: my guess

Black Bear.setting: a small wooded hilltop ringed by large boulders
Black Bear.prompt: A huge bear with a thick, shaggy dark coat, heavy shoulders and long curved claws, badly wounded, blood running from wounds in its neck and back. On all fours, it comes slowly out from behind a boulder, growling, head low, mouth open, its face creased with pain and fury, closing on the viewer.
beyond: shaggy coat, long curved claws, head low: my guess

Giak.setting: the ruins of a forest temple among tall pines, broken stone pillars and fallen blocks
Giak.prompt: A Giak: a small, ugly goblin-like soldier, much shorter than a man, wiry and stooped, standing on two legs as a man does, with man-like arms ending in clawed hands, coarse ashen hide, a broad snarling face with a wide mouth of jagged fangs, a heavy flat nose and pale glaring eyes full of malice, in a tall pointed helmet of dull bronze riveted round its rim and a jerkin of studded leather. It has scuttled up a broken stone pillar and now leaps down from its top, a long curved dagger clenched in its teeth and its clawed hands outstretched, straight at the viewer.

jagged fangs, heavy flat nose: ill4 (the front Giak's face)
clawed hands, much shorter than a man: my guess from "small"

Madman.setting: a broad city street, a doorway with its door flung open
Madman.prompt: A decrepit, wild old man, quite insane: a long, straggling beard, wide staring eyes behind small round spectacles, a floppy cap with a feather, a loose stained smock and patched hose. He bursts out through the door, screaming curses and accusations, deaf to all reason, a heavy meat cleaver raised high in one bony hand to hack at the viewer.
beyond: beard, staring eyes, spectacles, feathered cap, smock, patched hose: ill6

Giak + Doomwolf.setting: a path through sparse, hilly forest, leading down to an open meadow
Giak + Doomwolf.prompt: A Giak riding its Doomwolf, the pair as one foe. shaggy bristling fur: ill4, small17, 09tcof ill9

Giaks.setting: a country road at dusk, a broken-down wagon with one wheel jammed in a furrow
Giaks.prompt: Three Giaks: small, ugly goblin-like soldiers, much shorter than men, wiry and stooped, standing on two legs as men do, with coarse ashen hide, broad snarling faces with wide fanged mouths, heavy flat noses and pale glaring eyes full of malice, in tall pointed helmets of dull bronze and jerkins of studded leather. Winged Serpent.setting: an underground stone chamber, a granite throne with a glowing bowl on it, a dark stone floor
Winged Serpent.prompt: A large winged serpent, freshly burst from the stone statue that hid it: a long scaled snake body in an S curve, a wedge-shaped reptile head with open jaws, long fangs and a forked tongue, cold lidless eyes, and a pair of broad leathery bat wings spread wide from behind its head. Cracked shards and dust of its stone shell still fly from its body as it rears up off its plinth and lunges straight at the viewer, wings beating, jaws wide to strike. The serpent alone, no rider, no person.

scaled body, fangs, lidless eyes: my guess, from small16 and 09tcof ill5

Crypt Spawn.setting: a large stone chamber, two facing rows of skulls on stone plinths making a walkway, an eerie glow from the skulls, an archway beyond
Crypt Spawn.prompt: Crypt Spawn: ten hideous, slimy winged creatures, each the size of a cat, with a lumpy, folded body like a bare brain, small leathery bat wings, rows of suckers and long trailing bony limbs. Just hatched from skulls that have split open with a crack, they stretch their wings, rise together and swarm at the viewer.

size of a cat: my guess

Burrowcrawler.setting: a pitch-dark tunnel through a hillside, wider than it is high, roots hanging at its mouth
Burrowcrawler.prompt: A Burrowcrawler: a giant, heavy, slimy grub longer than a man, with a fat ringed body, a plated, spiny back, six jointed insect legs and a curling tail ending in a stinger; its blunt head bears snapping jaws amid a mass of long, writhing, slimy tentacles. It drops heavily from the tunnel roof onto the viewer, tentacles reaching to coil round the throat and strangle, a stench of rotting meat about it.
beyond: ringed body, plated back, jointed legs: ill11
stinger tail, six legs: the fan wiki

Leader.setting: a small footbridge on a country road
Leader.prompt: A rough-looking, unshaven bandit posing as a soldier, bloodstained, wearing a stolen garrison tunic, a crossbow slung over the pack on his back, and a costly, lavishly decorated sword far too fine for him. Having demanded money or life, he attacks the viewer with the ornate blade.

Soldier.setting: a small footbridge on a country road
Soldier.prompt: A bloodstained, unshaven bandit passing himself off as a soldier, in rough, stained clothes, an evil grin on his face, holding a costly, lavishly decorated sword far too fine for him. He rushes at the viewer, blade raised.

Bodyguard.setting: the open top half of a covered wagon's rear door, a road racing past below

beyond: burly, broad, sleeveless jerkin: my guess, from 06tkot ill3

Marshviper.setting: a wooded marsh, waist-deep slimy water, the air thick with stinging insects
Marshviper.prompt: A Marshviper: a long, thick-bodied venomous water snake with slick scales, its coils wrapped tight round the viewer's leg under the murky, slimy water, its flat wedge head rearing out of the water to strike, fangs bared.
beyond: thick body, slick scales, flat wedge head, fangs: my guess (the book names it and its bite only)

Robber.setting: a small, dark, musty shop, shelves of books and bottles of every size, a glass-topped counter, a toppling bamboo screen

Drakkar.setting: a small ferry boat out on a wide, still lake, a wooded shore far behind
Drakkar.prompt: A Drakkar: a strong warrior standing up in a small poled ferry boat, throwing back the hood of a heavy cloak to reveal a fearsome war-helm with a full face mask shaped like a snarling skull, crested with curling, horn-like flanges; a short sword in his fist. Doomwolf.setting: a woodland path sloping down to an open meadow
Doomwolf.prompt: A Doomwolf: a large, vicious wolf far bigger than any common wolf, big enough to carry a rider, with a coarse shaggy coat bristling along the neck and back, a long muzzle, ears laid back and a snarling mouth packed with razor-sharp fangs. One of four that come on one after another, it charges down the path at full stretch on all fours, straight at the viewer, jaws wide. The beast alone.

ears laid back, long muzzle: my guess

Gourgaz.setting: a stone bridge in a forest, spent arrows on its stones
Gourgaz.prompt: A Gourgaz: a giant, cold-blooded reptile warrior standing upright on two legs as a man does: a heavy, scaly, pebbled hide, a ridged belly, a long snout-like head with heavy-lidded eyes and a lipless mouth, and clawed hands and feet. arrows on the bridge: my guess, from the arrows flying past

Helghast.setting: a cramped ship's hold, lantern-lit, crates and coiled rope, creaking timbers
Helghast.prompt: A Helghast: a gaunt undead servant of dark sorcery, standing upright on two legs as a man does, wrapped in a dark hooded cloak. Its hands are shrivelled and dark, tipped with claws. Shrieking, it rushes at the viewer, a twisted dark-bladed sword swung low to hack at the legs.

sword swung low: my reading of the fight

Wounded Helghast.setting: a cramped ship's hold beside a splintered door, dim lantern light, crates and rope
Wounded Helghast.prompt: A Helghast, badly wounded: a gaunt undead thing standing upright on two legs as a man does, in a dark hooded cloak, a deep fresh gash torn open across its chest. Its face is shrunken, rotting flesh drawn tight over the skull, eyes burning with a fierce glow, fangs bared; its hands are shrivelled and clawed. Screaming with pain and fury, it springs forward through a broken doorway at the viewer, its dark-bladed sword held high.
beyond: hooded cloak, clawed hands: ill8 and the foe-about (wiki)
rotting face, glowing eyes, fangs: the Helghast as other sections show it (106)

Dorier + Ganon.setting: a lamplit roadside inn room, an overturned table and wooden benches
Dorier + Ganon.prompt: Two knight brothers fighting side by side: tall, lean, stern men of a holy order of knighthood, with long pale faces, high cheekbones and long hair, one with dark hair to his shoulders, the other fair, a round star-like brooch pinning his cloak. mail and surcoat: my guess for knights travelling

Ganon + Dorier.setting: a smoky tavern, a heavy table and wooden benches, shadowy corners

mail and surcoat: my guess for knights travelling

Zombie Crew.setting: the rotten lower deck of a sunken ship, sagging timbers, a hole smashed in the planks above, dripping gloom
Zombie Crew.prompt: Four zombies, the drowned crew of a ship raised from the sea floor by sorcery: walking corpses with sodden, rotting flesh, bloated or shrunken, weed and barnacles clinging to them, hollow eye sockets and slack hanging jaws, hair matted with brine. They wear the tattered shirts, breeches and jackets of sailors. Out of the gloom of a rotten deck they stagger together at the viewer, twisted, broken hands stretched out to seize the throat.

Giaks.setting: a narrow ship's cabin, a bunk and a splintered door, shouting and torchlight outside
Giaks.prompt: Three Giaks: small, spiteful goblin foot soldiers, each standing upright on two legs as a man does, squat and wiry, with ashen, warty, mottled hides, broad heads, flat noses, pointed ears and wide mouths full of jagged fangs, small mean eyes. Halvorc.setting: a lamplit inn bar, a large table with scattered cups, wooden benches

Zombie Captain.setting: the weed-hung deck of a sunken ship raised from the sea, rotten rigging, drifting sea fog
Zombie Captain.prompt: A zombie sea captain: the drowned master of a sunken ship, raised as a walking corpse, standing upright as a man does. His body is twisted and disfigured, flesh sodden and peeling, the eyes gone to hollow sockets, the jaw hanging loose. A torn captain's coat and jacket cling to him, weed tangled in them. One broken hand reaches out; with the other he pulls a wicked, crooked knife out of the rags of his coat and closes on the viewer.

weed tangled in the clothes: my guess for a drowned man

Viveka.setting: a lamplit inn room, a table kicked over, wooden floor and shadowy walls

Lightning-quick, she has kicked over the table between them and lunges at the viewer with a drawn short sword, perfectly balanced.

Villager.setting: a narrow creaking wooden stair in a poor seaside shop, a hearth on the landing above

He charges up a narrow wooden staircase at the viewer, part of a lynch mob, swinging a woodcutter's axe over his head.

Szall.setting: a narrow creaking wooden stair in a poor seaside shop, a hearth on the landing above
Szall.prompt: A Szall: a small, scrawny, ugly goblin, a weak and cowardly offshoot of the Giaks, standing upright on two legs as a man does. Shrieking and squealing, it scrambles up a narrow wooden staircase at the viewer, jabbing a crude short spear.

Watchtower Guard.setting: a stone stair inside a town watchtower archway, damp walls, a guttering torch

Furious, he charges down a stone stair at the viewer, his sword lifted high above his head for a cleaving blow.

Street Thief.setting: a narrow rain-soaked town street at the mouth of an alley, wet cobbles, dingy houses

Priest.setting: a lamplit inn bar, a large table and wooden benches, heavy shadows

Knight of the White Mountain.setting: trodden ground cleared before an iron-clad tower door deep in a forest

mountain emblem, surcoat, cloak: my guess

Drakkar.setting: a merchant ship's deck after a ramming, splintered timber, tangled rigging, billowing sails
Drakkar.prompt: A Drakkar: a cruel, heavily built warrior of the dark armies, standing upright as a man does, clad all in dark armour and mail, a full helm with a narrow eye-slit and a crest of spikes hiding his face, a dark cloak at his back. He advances across the deck through the fray, raising a large dark-bladed broadsword above his head with both hands to bring it down on the viewer.

cloak: my guess

Trickster.setting: a smoky tavern, rough tables and tankards, playing cards scattered, flickering lamps
Trickster.prompt: A card cheat: a sleek, narrow-faced man with oiled hair, a thin moustache and a sly, menacing smile, in a fitted jacket whose sleeves hide marked cards, rings on his fingers. Accused, he turns on the viewer, draws a curved dagger and attacks, knife held low.

Harbour Thugs.setting: a smoky harbour tavern, a splintered door crashing open, rough tables and tankards
Harbour Thugs.prompt: Three harbour thugs: hulking dockside hired killers, unshaven and scarred, in rough sailors' shirts, leather jerkins and sea-boots, headscarves knotted over their hair, a serpent tattoo on each one's wrist. Sailor.setting: a rowdy waterfront tavern, a sturdy scarred table at its centre, ale tankards and coins
Sailor.prompt: A grim, brutal sailor: a big, thick-necked man with heavy, tattooed forearms, weathered skin, stubble, an old scar across his face, cold eyes and a sneer. He wears a sleeveless salt-stained shirt, a knife at his belt. He sits across a scarred table, one elbow planted, his huge hand thrust out at the viewer to lock grips in an arm-wrestling match he means to win by breaking the viewer's arm.

Bridge Guard.setting: a narrow bridge over a deep rushing gorge, a small flat-roofed hut at its middle, forest on both banks
Bridge Guard.prompt: A border soldier of a forest kingdom: a tall, disciplined man-at-arms in a steel cap and a mail shirt under a livery coat, gloved hands, a sword at his hip. Offended in his honour, he stabs at the viewer with a long spear, trying to drive the viewer off the edge of the bridge.

Town Guard.setting: a lamplit seaside tavern, overturned stools, spilled drinks, shuttered windows

Town Guard Sergeant.setting: a lamplit seaside tavern, overturned stools, spilled drinks, shuttered windows

Town Guard Corporal.setting: a lamplit seaside tavern, overturned stools, spilled drinks, shuttered windows

Border Guard.setting: a wooden border tower where a road enters a pine forest, dusty track, tall trees

Ice Barbarian.setting: a snow-swept frozen trail under a bitter wind, ice ridges and drifting flakes

bone armour, slanted eyes, cheekbones: ill12 and the text of 216

Kalkoth.setting: a glittering ice cave with icicles hanging overhead and a frost-slick floor
Kalkoth.prompt: A Kalkoth: a large, heavy predator of the frozen mountains, on all fours, built like a great cat crossed with a bear, with thick shaggy fur and a ragged mane about a broad, ugly head. Its small eyes smoulder like hot coals; its wide jaws gape over long fangs, and from them lashes a long whip-like tongue ending in a barbed, venomous sting. Huge clawed paws, powerful haunches. It bounds low across the ice at the viewer, jaws wide, the barbed tongue darting at the viewer's face.
beyond: cat and bear build, mane, haunches: my guess, from small14

Baknar.setting: a windswept camp among upthrust ice pillars, a canvas tent, snow whirling in eddies
Baknar.prompt: A Baknar: a huge, hunched carnivore of the frozen coast, on all fours, bulky as a great ape or bear and covered in a thick, long, shaggy pale coat. Two long horns, ringed and ridged, curve back from its brow; its face is ape-like and flat-nosed under heavy brows, with small fierce eyes. It roars, jaws gaping wide over long fangs, and lopes through the blowing snow at the viewer, great hooked claws reaching out. A foul stench clings to it.

Ice Barbarian Mutants.setting: a long stone causeway across a vast furnace-lit hall, stone vats of bubbling slime hung over fires far below
Ice Barbarian Mutants.prompt: Four Ice Barbarian mutants: once tall warriors of the frozen wastes, now mutilated and twisted by a necromancer's experiments, still standing upright on two legs as men do but barely: skin peeled back and crudely stitched, bodies swollen and misshapen, limbs bent the wrong way, faces slack and pitiful, eyes empty. Javek.setting: a narrow rocky ledge above a deep abyss, cold mist rising
Javek.prompt: A Javek: a long, sinuous ice snake with two heads on two necks forking from one thick scaled body, which slithers fast along the ledge. Both heads are wedge-shaped with cold, lidless eyes; one rears high, the other strikes, its jaws stretched wide to bare long, curved fangs dripping with venom. The serpent rises off the stone and darts both heads at the viewer.
beyond: scaled body, wedge-shaped heads, lidless eyes: ill6 and my guess

Doomwolf.setting: a gloomy stone cell in a fortress, torchlight on cold walls and a hidden archway
Doomwolf.prompt: A Doomwolf: a huge wolf of the dark lands, on all fours, bigger than a pony, with a thick, shaggy, matted coat, a broad heavy head, ears laid back and lips drawn back from long razor fangs, slavering, eyes narrowed. Powerful shoulders, big clawed paws. Snarling, it races out of a hidden archway and charges at the viewer, leaping with its jaws open.

Helghast.setting: a dark stone passage at the head of a descending stair, cold fortress walls
Helghast.prompt: A Helghast: an undead shape-changer standing upright on two legs as a man does, painfully thin, in long ragged robes of a prisoner, its disguise slipping away. Its face is skeletal and rotting under a loose hood, its eyes glowing fiercely with hatred and fear; its fingers are long, bony and steel-hard, hot enough to burn. It shrieks, recoils from the light, then lunges at the viewer, skeletal hands reaching for the throat.
beyond: rotting skeletal face, hood: the foe-about (wiki) and 02fotw ill8
ragged robes: my guess (it wears robes at 230 and posed as a prisoner)

Ice Barbarians.setting: a dim fortress corridor of carved ice and stone, frost on the walls
Ice Barbarians.prompt: Three possessed Ice Barbarians: tall, fur-clad warriors of the frozen wastes in shaggy furs and plates of bone armour, slanted eyes and sharp cheekbones, but their eyes are blank, pale and without pupils. beyond: bone armour, slanted eyes, cheekbones: ill12 and the text of 216
